culprit_citations.quoted_text: Funded row discloses SOFR(Q) + 6.25% and Interest Rate 11.26% for a First lien investment.
Unfunded row for Notorious Topco shows First lien - Undrawn with reference, spread, and interest rate all shown as dashes.
Interest Rate Type summary shows Floating rates at 99.91% of total investments at fair value.

findings.detail: The rate-fill warning appears to count unfunded commitment rows even though the source schedule explicitly has no rate terms for those rows.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. The raw schedule separates funded debt rows, which carry reference, spread, and interest-rate values, from unfunded debt rows, which are labeled Undrawn and show dashes/blanks in the reference, spread, and interest-rate columns. The filing also provides an interest-rate-type summary totaling 100% of investments, including 99.91% floating-rate exposure. The observed 66.5% fill warning is therefore not evidence of dropped source rates; it is caused by applying the rate-fill check to rows where the raw source does not disclose an interest rate because they are unfunded commitments.
